title: Unify Glass UI Style
description: Make the shared @ui glass design system the single canonical window style and refactor every UI (CAD, playground, platform, procedural, flow) to consume it identically, removing all divergent local/hardcoded chrome.
summary: Verified procedural play at runtime uses the same ProductShell glass chrome as CAD (ui-glass-panel side panels, ui-glass-window-options measures rail). Moved preview Transform Detail from a local floating overlay into shell window measures on the preview window kind. Added createProductPlaygroundPlatform() in @semio-tech/framework-playground-core and switched procedural/flow/dag/gis/presentation play harnesses to use it for centralized panel visibility defaults.
